segments.name: Solid-state battery technology
segments.description: Develops and manufactures sulfide-based solid electrolyte and solid-state cells for battery manufacturers and automotive original equipment manufacturers that make their own cells.
segments.evidence: We currently conduct our business through one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs pay for electrolyte and licensing of cell manufacturing processes; government contracts and collaborative agreements also provide funding.
revenueModel.evidence: Our commercialization strategy is to manufacture and sell electrolyte to Tier 1 battery manufacturers and automotive original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") that choose to produce their own battery cells.
